content: CarPlay entitlement process verified from June 2026 CarPlay Developer Guide: request at developer.apple.com/carplay, agree to CarPlay Entitlement Addendum, Apple reviews request against category criteria before assigning entitlement; then create new provisioning profile with CarPlay capability, disable automatic signing in Xcode. Categories now include audio, communication, driving task, EV charging, fueling, navigation, parking, public safety, QSR, video, voice-based conversational. Video apps must support AirPlay video streaming and parked-only playback. No published SLA for review time (community reports range days to months); timeline outside developer control. Entitlement is account-level, tied to App ID.
